intro.zh: 中国工程院院士、北京科技大学终身教授和博士生导师，长期从事绿色低碳钢铁冶金教学与科研。研究涵盖电弧炉复合吹炼、钢液深度净化和CO₂资源化炼钢，推动技术工程示范与产业应用。获国家科技进步二等奖4项、何梁何利科学与技术进步奖和全国创新争先奖，长期主讲《炼钢学》。
intro.en: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, tenured professor and doctoral supervisor at USTB. His teaching and research cover combined-blowing electric arc furnaces, deep purification of molten steel and CO₂ utilization in steelmaking, with engineering demonstrations and industrial applications. Honors include four State Science and Technology Progress Second Prizes, the Ho Leung Ho Lee Science and Technology Progress Award and the National Innovation Award. He has taught Steelmaking for three decades.

intro.en: Professor and doctoral supervisor at USTB. He earned his PhD in ferrous metallurgy in 2012 and subsequently undertook postdoctoral and visiting research. His work combines numerical simulation, experiments and industrial process optimization in electric arc furnace and converter steelmaking, metallurgical energy efficiency, environmental protection, automatic control and software models.

intro.zh: 北京科技大学教授、博士生导师，国家自然科学基金优秀青年基金获得者，入选中国科协青年人才托举工程等人才计划。主要研究绿色低碳炼钢、再生金属熔体净化调控与CO₂资源化利用，承担教育部学科突破先导项目课题等科研任务。获国家科技进步二等奖、北京市科技进步一等奖和教育部技术发明一等奖等。

He leads research including a Ministry of Education discipline-breakthrough project. Honors include a State Science and Technology Progress Second Prize, a Beijing Science and Technology Progress First Prize and a Ministry of Education Technological Invention First Prize.

title.zh: 央视报道！国内首个！院士团队变“废钢”为绿钢！
title.en: CCTV reports on the team’s near-zero-carbon steelmaking demonstration

summary.zh: 朱荣院士团队牵头攻关的近零碳排电炉短流程炼钢国家级示范项目在靖江特钢投产。
summary.en: A national demonstration project led by Academician Rong Zhu’s team has entered production at Jingjiang Special Steel.

source.zh: 北京科技大学微信公众号 · 央视新闻报道
source.en: USTB WeChat account · CCTV News coverage

paragraphs.zh: 据北京科技大学2026年10月15日发布的报道，由朱荣院士科研团队牵头攻关的国内首个近零碳排电炉短流程炼钢国家级示范项目在靖江特钢投产。
paragraphs.en: According to USTB’s report published on 15 October 2026, China’s first national demonstration project for near-zero-carbon short-route EAF steelmaking, developed under the leadership of Rong Zhu’s team, entered production at Jingjiang Special Steel.

paragraphs.zh: 项目以再生钢铁原料为主要生产原料，采用生物质燃气、生物质炭等替代传统化石燃料，结合光伏、风电等绿色能源，以电代煤，重熔废钢制造高品质特种钢。
paragraphs.en: The project uses recycled steel feedstock, biomass gas and biomass char in place of conventional fossil fuels, together with solar, wind and other green electricity, to remelt scrap into high-quality special steel.

paragraphs.zh: 报道介绍，项目通过能源、冶炼过程与原料端协同减碳，并采用CO₂喷吹控氮和终点控氧等洁净化技术，在降低碳排放的同时改善钢水质量。
paragraphs.en: The report describes coordinated carbon reduction in energy supply, the melting process and feedstock production. CO₂ injection for nitrogen control and end-point oxygen control support improved steel quality while reducing emissions.

paragraphs.zh: 报道所述“100%绿电+100%废钢+高效电炉”短流程炼钢模式，相对传统长流程炼钢可实现碳排放90%以上减排。该数据对应报道中的示范项目及比较条件。
paragraphs.en: The reported “100% green electricity + 100% scrap + efficient EAF” route achieves more than 90% lower carbon emissions than conventional integrated steelmaking under the demonstration project’s stated comparison conditions.

title.zh: 朱荣院士团队斩获第三十届全国发明展览会金奖
title.en: Team wins Gold at the 30th National Invention Exhibition

summary.zh: “钢铁流程CO₂捕集与资源化利用”成果获展会金奖，推动工业尾气CO₂向冶金功能介质转变。
summary.en: The CO₂ capture and utilization project received a Gold Award for turning industrial CO₂ into a functional metallurgical medium.

source.zh: 绿色低碳钢铁冶金全国重点实验室微信公众号
source.en: National Key Laboratory of Green and Low-Carbon Iron and Steel Metallurgy WeChat account

paragraphs.zh: 据实验室2026年9月27日发布的报道，第三十届全国发明展览会于9月23日至25日举办，朱荣院士团队完成的“钢铁流程CO₂捕集与资源化利用”项目获得金奖。
paragraphs.en: According to the laboratory’s report of 27 September 2026, the team’s project on CO₂ capture and utilization in steel production won a Gold Award at the 30th National Invention Exhibition, held from 23 to 25 September.

paragraphs.zh: 该项目面向钢铁流程碳排放强度高、工业尾气难捕集及炼钢洁净化要求高等问题，构建“工业尾气CO₂捕集提纯—多工序冶金利用—能源与物质协同转化”技术体系，实现减碳、减污、节能与提质协同。
paragraphs.en: The project addresses carbon-intensive steel production, difficult industrial off-gas capture and demanding steel-cleanliness requirements. It integrates CO₂ capture and purification, utilization across metallurgical operations, and coordinated energy and material conversion.

paragraphs.zh: 报道介绍，项目已完成工程化示范并推广至10余家钢铁企业。在首钢京唐建成的示范工程，年产5万吨石灰窑尾气CO₂捕集资源化利用，并应用于300吨转炉顶底复吹冶炼。
paragraphs.en: The report states that engineering demonstrations have been completed and the technology deployed at more than ten steel enterprises. A demonstration at Shougang Jingtang captures and utilizes 50,000 tonnes of CO₂ per year from lime-kiln off-gas and supplies CO₂ for combined top-and-bottom blowing in a 300-tonne converter.

title.zh: 电弧炉绿色高效洁净智能冶炼技术
title.en: Green, efficient, clean and intelligent EAF steelmaking

body.zh: 团队自主研发电弧炉炼钢复合吹炼成套技术与装备，创新搭建智能化能效评价系统与高效协同供能模型。有效缩短电弧炉冶炼周期、显著提升钢水洁净度，实现能源精准最优匹配，解决底吹寿命与炉龄不匹配行业难题。目前该技术已成功推广应用于国内外百余座电弧炉，产业化落地成效显著。
body.en: The team developed integrated combined-blowing technologies and equipment, an intelligent energy-efficiency evaluation system and a coordinated energy-supply model. These advances shorten EAF melting cycles, improve steel cleanliness, optimize energy matching and align bottom-blowing component life with furnace campaigns. The technology has been applied in more than 100 EAFs in China and abroad.

title.zh: 钢铁流程CO₂回收资源化利用技术
title.en: CO₂ recovery and utilization in steel production

body.zh: 牵头完成“十二五”国家科技支撑课题《CO₂-O₂混合喷吹炼钢工艺技术及装备示范》，率先实现CO₂资源化赋能钢铁冶炼。技术应用后，可实现转炉冶炼烟尘源头减量超10%、煤气品质与产量提升超5%、单吨炼钢节能超4 kgce、CO₂减排超20 kg；在电弧炉冶炼场景中，可将钢水氮含量稳定控制在45 ppm以下，攻克高品质钢冶炼核心技术瓶颈。
body.en: The team led the 12th Five-Year National Science and Technology Support project on CO₂–O₂ mixed-injection steelmaking processes and equipment demonstration. Reported outcomes include more than 10% less converter dust at source, over 5% improvement in gas quality and output, and savings exceeding 4 kgce and 20 kg CO₂ per tonne of steel. In EAF steelmaking, the process keeps steel nitrogen below 45 ppm.

title.zh: 转炉高效低碳冶炼技术
title.en: Efficient, low-carbon converter steelmaking

body.zh: 原创研发转炉底吹O₂-CO₂-石灰粉高效低碳冶炼技术，搭建智能化喷粉专家系统，实现转炉冶炼喷粉全自动一键式智能操作。创新采用CO₂作为底吹元件冷却气体，率先在国内120 t、300 t大型转炉实现工业化应用。同时开发转炉底吹生物质炭高比例冷料冶炼工艺，冷料占比≥40%，可实现长流程炼钢碳排放降低超30%，低碳降碳成效突出。
body.en: The team developed converter bottom injection of O₂, CO₂ and lime powder, supported by an intelligent powder-injection expert system for fully automated one-touch operation. CO₂ cooling of bottom-blowing components was industrially implemented in 120 t and 300 t converters in China. A biomass-char bottom-blowing process enables a cold-charge ratio of at least 40% and a reported reduction of more than 30% in emissions from the integrated steelmaking route.

title.zh: 冶金固废高值化循环利用技术
title.en: High-value recycling of metallurgical solid waste

body.zh: 首创钢铁/有色冶金固废“元素-资源-工艺”多维协同循环利用理论，研发固废有价元素低碳提取、尾渣高值化改性成套技术。可高效回收冶金渣、尘泥、危废中的Fe、Zn、Pb、Cu等核心金属，实现跨产业循环利用；尾渣可加工为冶金熔剂、多孔陶瓷、微晶玻璃等功能材料及水泥、石材等建材，技术已广泛应用于国内多家钢铁、有色、环保龙头企业，实现固废变废为宝、绿色循环。
body.en: The team proposed an element–resource–process framework for coordinated recycling of ferrous and non-ferrous metallurgical waste and developed low-carbon recovery of valuable elements and high-value residual-slag modification. Fe, Zn, Pb and Cu are recovered from slags, dusts, sludges and hazardous waste for cross-industry reuse. Residual slags become metallurgical fluxes, porous ceramics, glass-ceramics, cement and stone products. The technologies have been adopted by Chinese steel, non-ferrous and environmental companies.

overview.zh: 朱荣院士领衔的绿色低碳炼钢团队，长期面向国家“双碳”战略和钢铁工业绿色低碳转型重大需求，深耕绿色低碳钢铁冶金基础研究、关键技术攻关与工程化应用。团队围绕低碳炼钢、洁净钢生产、CO₂资源化利用等关键技术领域持续攻坚，揭示了CO₂调控炼钢反应机理，开发了CO₂顶底复合喷吹、源头降尘、高效脱磷、强化脱氮及多元气体耦合调控等关键技术，推动CO₂由工业废气向资源功能型介质的转变，为高品质钢绿色生产和钢铁流程减碳提供了重要技术路径；主持研发了电炉炼钢复合吹炼技术，有效破解了能量利用率低等难题；发明了钢液深度净化技术，成功突破了全废钢低氮、低磷钢冶炼技术瓶颈；研发全球首例氢基竖炉—近零碳排电弧炉技术，为钢铁工业低碳冶炼提供重要技术支撑。
overview.en: Led by Academician Rong Zhu, the Green & Low-Carbon Steelmaking Team addresses China’s carbon-peaking and carbon-neutrality goals and the steel industry’s green transition through fundamental research, key technology development and engineering applications. The team investigates low-carbon steelmaking, clean steel production and CO₂ utilization. It has elucidated how CO₂ regulates steelmaking reactions and developed combined top-and-bottom CO₂ injection, dust reduction at source, efficient dephosphorization, enhanced nitrogen removal and coupled multi-gas control. These advances turn CO₂ from an industrial waste gas into a functional process medium, supporting cleaner high-quality steel and lower process emissions. The team has also developed combined-blowing electric steelmaking to improve energy utilization, deep steel-melt purification for low-nitrogen and low-phosphorus production from all-scrap charges, and the world’s first hydrogen-based shaft furnace–near-zero-carbon electric arc furnace technology.

overview.zh: 团队坚持产学研深度融合，相关技术成果已在全国200余家钢企推广应用。近年来，团队成员主持国家级、省部级及校企合作项目100余项，先后获国家科技进步二等奖4项（三项第一）、何梁何利科学与技术进步奖、全国创新争先奖、省部级特等奖1项、一等奖8项，发表论文210余篇，授权国内外专利110余项，制定国家及行业标准9项，出版专著8部，相关成果入选国家工信部低碳技术目录等。
overview.en: The team integrates university research with industry practice, with technologies deployed at more than 200 steel enterprises across China. In recent years, its members have led over 100 national, provincial, ministerial and university–industry projects; received four Second Prizes of the State Science and Technology Progress Award, with the team ranked first in three, the Ho Leung Ho Lee Science and Technology Progress Award, the National Innovation Award, one provincial or ministerial Special Prize and eight First Prizes; published over 210 papers; secured over 110 Chinese and international patents; developed nine national and industry standards; and published eight monographs. Its achievements have been included in the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology’s catalogue of low-carbon technologies.
